id./param/scenario/cs/b_070_cs_060.pack|cs_: "You've returned, both of you. The star suddenly shattered, so I worried, but I'm glad you're safe.
"Faris told me. When the star fell and all seemed lost, a savior appeared and cut it down.
"Whether he's a savior, I can't say... but never mind. I have something to ask you.
"As I saw, the barrier around the star was inscribed with Calasmos. Does that word ring a bell?
"...Cala... smos? Hmm... It doesn't sound familiar.
"A word carved on the star in the sky. It must have deep meaning...
"No help for it. We still have the vital mission of beating Mordegon. Let's hurry on.
"Lord Robert, we'll support your quest to defeat Mordegon, in our small way.
"If you're ever in trouble, tell us anything. This time I'll help {var:1}!
"Oh, no, I nearly forgot. Let's ask the Sultan about Erdwin's hammer."
